summary: A message promoted a supposed gold backed crypto coin and free wallet signup promising free funds and future gains. The website and claims are used to lure victims into a fake token and wallet ecosystem that later extracts deposits or fees.
user_mistake: trusted promotional claims about a new coin and free wallet shared by a friend
prevention: Do not create accounts or wallets for coins promoted through unsolicited referral messages / Warn the friend and disengage from the platform
